newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police seize 50 kg of heroin at Red Sea.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police seize 50 kg of heroin at Red Sea.

text.p: Egyptian police on Tuesday seized 50 kg (110 pounds) of heroin and were closing in on six suspected drug smugglers hiding in Red Sea coves, security sources said.

They said a ferry was believed to have supplied the smugglers -- five Egyptians and one Jordanian -- with the drugs which they then hid in the coves between the Jordanian port of Aqaba and the Egyprian port of Noweiba.
